understanding the neurobiological basis of behavioral flexibility and consolidation in social behavior.
understanding the neurobiology of social behavior in flies and its relevance in human behavior.
the molecular and neural mechanisms underlying behavioral flexibility and consolidation in the context of social interactions in Drosophilla.
